jobs.title: Viz Assist
jobs.description: Home / Viz Assist Viz Assist™ Better Care, Less Friction. Powered by Agentic AI. Request a demo AI That Works Like a Teammate Autonomous AI agents that surface what matters, when it matters — so care moves faster. Viz Assist is designed to work alongside clinicians, using generative AI to deliver real-time insights and guideline-based recommendations directly within the Viz Platform. From pre-charting to documentation, Viz Assist handles the busywork so clinicians can focus on what matters most: patient care. Reduce Burden. Recover Time. Refocus on Care. Cut Chart Review Time What could take up to 2 hours to prep for clinic is now done for you. That’s time back for patients — or simply to go home on time. Support Complete Documentation Viz Assist surfaces key details from the EHR, imaging, and ambient data to help streamline documentation and support accurate coding. Close Gaps in Care From defibrillator referrals to anticoagulation management, Viz Assist surfaces missed opportunities to intervene sooner. Ease Staff Burnout Fewer clicks. Less cognitive load. More human connection. Efficiency that Scales Actionable outputs that keep patients moving through care without additional logins or switching between tools. Automated Chart Summarization Relevant, concise information curated for decision-making. We do the busywork so you can spend time where it matters most. Guideline-Based Recommendations Multimodal data analyzed against guidelines is surfaced for your review to support faster, more confident treatment decisions. Ambient Listening Automated documentation based on recorded doctor-patient interactions drafts clinic notes, patient letters, referral notes and suggested billing codes to support documentation accuracy. Billing & Coding Referenceable ICD-10 & CPT coding suggestions to drive better financial resiliency. Capture the full value of care delivered. What clinicians are saying This platform does far more than simply send alerts — it works seamlessly in the background to identify critical patients, automates clinical documentation which saves us time, delivers the most relevant information in real time, and coordinates action across the entire care team. It is so helpful. You have no idea. That’s the most painful work of a new patient visit—digging through the dumpster fire of the EMRs and trying to pull out the relevant details. And this does it for me instantly. I’m grateful this is a much safer and secure way to do it [send patient details], including the scrollable images. Especially when I’m working across different hospitals…I can get to the right patient, faster.
